# SelectionSphere

- Inherits [`Adornment`](adornment.md)
- Created with `Instance.new("SelectionSphere")`

The outline of a part's or a model's bounding sphere: the circle it shows the camera, its rim in `Color3` and its inside in `SurfaceColor3`.

This page lists the members this class declares. Inherited members are
listed on the page of the class that declares them.

## Properties

| Name | Type | Default | Access | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `LineThickness` | `number` | `0.05` | read/write | How thick the rim is, in meters. |
| `SurfaceColor3` | `Color3` | `Color3.new(0.05, 0.41, 0.68)` | read/write | The color inside the rim. |
| `SurfaceTransparency` | `number` | `1` | read/write | How transparent the inside is, from 0 (solid) to 1 (only the rim is drawn). |
